description: BMW E46 M3 SMG II (Siemens SMG2 510): decode the calibration — shift speed thresholds per gear and program (AUTO, SPORT/RACE, Drivelogic), gear ratios, clutch and launch settings — through the MS4X definition with E46M3SMG2 /// MAPPING's corrections. Pass item for one item's full table and axes.

image_path.description: Path to an SMG II 510 image on this machine: the 24 KiB calibration window (24,576 bytes) or the full 512 KiB flash (524,288 bytes).

item.description: A uniqueId (e.g. 0x7695) or words of a title (e.g. "A1 Speed"); matching items come back with every cell and axis.

xdf_path.description: Path to the MS4X definition on this machine: Siemens_SMG_II_510_24K.xdf for a 24 KiB window, Siemens_SMG_II_510_512K.xdf for a full read. It is MS4X's and not shipped with this package.

name: smg2_read
title: Decode an SMG II calibration
